discription: A warm sawtooth wave synth with a low-pass filter and an ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, cutoff=2000, rq=0.5; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.5, 0.7, 1.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = Saw.ar(freq); sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
